items.name: Estcubes Open 2026

venue.name: Tallinn University of Applied Sciences
venue.details: On the third floor in main hall.

items.information:
![Eesti kuubik](https://i.imgur.com/Cr7XSizt.png)
Tere tulemast võistlusele Estcubes Open 2026! See saab olema eriline võistlus, kus ametlikud WCA alad on kombineeritud erinevate põnevate mitteametlike aladega.
Osalema on oodatud kõik, olenemata sellest, kas suudad kuubiku lahendada 5 sekundiga või 5 minutiga.
Palume tutvuda kõigi selle lehe vahelehtedega, sest need sisaldavad olulist teavet võistluse kohta.

Welcome to Estcubes Open 2026! This will be a very special competition, where the WCA events are mixed with a variety of special unoffical events.
Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you can solve a cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.
We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

items.name: Twist 'n Turn Tallinn 2022

venue.name: [Tallinn Secondary School of Science](https://real.edu.ee/english/)
venue.details: On the second floor in main hall.

items.information:
Welcome to the biggest competition yet in Estonia!

If you are **at least 12 years old**, after arriving at the venue you must present one of the following:

1. Proof of vaccination against Covid-19. Vaccination has to be completed;
2. Proof that you have recovered from Covid-19. The positive test result must be newer than six months;

Alternatively, competitors/guests who are **12 to 17 years old** may present a negative result from either a PCR test (no older than 72h) or an antigen test (no older than 48h) (tests performed by a medical professional).

Wearing a mask at the competition venue is **mandatory**.

---

Tere tulemast seni kõige suuremale Eesti võistlusele!

Kui olete **vähemalt 12-aastane**, peate esitama ühe järgmisest kahest dokumendist:

1. Covid-19 vastase vaktsineerimise tõendi, kusjuures vaktsineerimiskuur peab olema lõpetatud;
2. Covid-19 läbipõdemise tõendi, kusjuures positiivne testitulemus peab olema saadud viimase kuue kuu jooksul;

Võistlejad/külalised, kes on **12-17 aasta vanused**, võivad selle asemel esitada negatiivse PCR testi tulemuse (mitte vanem kui 72 h) või negatiivse antigeeni kiirtesti tulemuse (mitte vanem kui 48 h), kusjuures testi peab olema läbi viinud meditsiinitöötaja - tulemus peab kajastuma Digiloos.

Võistluspaigas on maskikandmine **kohustuslik**.


![Eesti kuubik](https://i.imgur.com/Cr7XSizt.png)

items.information:
[Schedule](http://www.wombat.pri.ee/failid/Ajakava2010eng.pdf). Only competition in the Baltic countries! Participation fee will be 150 EEK (100 for the competition and 50 for the two lunches) or just 10 €. Transportation from Tallinn and accommodation will be organized. For more information visit the competition website.
The goal is to make this a Rubik's competition where the most records are made (last year there were even 2 WR!). [Images from last year](http://www.wombat.pri.ee/fotod/EstonianOpen09/).
